🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can measure a map and find the real distance

✓ I can find the length on the map from a real distance

✓ I can draw a real object to scale on a grid

So you can read any map, plan or floor plan!

📏 Scale

1 cm on the map = ?

1 cm on the map = a real distance

➡️ Map to real

? the map length by the scale

× multiply the map length by the scale

⬅️ Real to map

? the real distance by the scale

Divide the real distance by the scale

📐 Units

1 km = ? m

1 km = 1000 m

📐 Units

1 m = ? cm

1 m = 100 cm

Measure from the EDGE of each place. Start at 0 on the ruler.

🏠 Menu

🍟 Free delivery?

The chippy only delivers free if you live UNDER 1 km away.

1 cm on the map represents 200 m. Do I get free delivery? (1 km = 1000 m; 1 m = 100 cm)

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Read the scale

1 cm = 200 m

Step 2

Measure Chippy to My flat

4 cm

Step 3

Map to real: × 200

4 × 200 = 800 m

YES! 800 m is under 1 km 🍟

🔐 Crack the safe

Measure on each map. Each answer is one number of the code. Chat first, then click!

1

Library to Sports Hall. 1 cm represents 10 m. How many metres?

🔒

60

6 cm × 10 = 60 m

2

Cinema to Car Park. 1 cm represents 30 m. How many metres?

🔒

90

3 cm × 30 = 90 m

3

Campsite to Lake. 1 cm represents 2 km. How many kilometres?

🔒

9

4.5 cm × 2 = 9 km

🔓 The code is 60 · 90 · 9 – the safe is OPEN! 💰
